title: The Gift of the Magi: English short story with meanings
description: Read The Gift of the Magi by O. Henry in English: the full text, tap a word for a simple meaning. Level B1, about 14 minutes, with a word list.
intro: On Christmas Eve, Della has one dollar and eighty-seven cents to buy a present for her husband Jim. O. Henry's famous story is short and full of dialogue, a good B1 read, with the 1900s words explained as you go.
